documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers has transitioned from a trading-led model to a manufacturing-driven company following the commencement of commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY27 and shift the revenue mix to a 50-50 split between manufacturing and trading. The company is focusing on debt reduction using internal accruals and plans to expand its product portfolio into non-textile industries. Despite global macro uncertainties, the company remains optimistic about domestic demand and its ability to pass on raw material cost increases. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting revenue growth and a strategic shift from trading to manufacturing.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 50-50 revenue mix between manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins are expected to increase by 2% to 3% in the coming years.
guidance.quote: See as I've been already mentioned the basis -- basically when we are doing the manufacturing, naturally the profit margin is little bit higher in the manufacturing segment. So, overall profit margin you can consider it 2% to 3% will be higher in the coming years.

guidance.claim: Management expects trading and manufacturing to each contribute 50% of revenues within 1 to 2 years.
guidance.quote: Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal. Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

guidance.claim: At full utilization of its 500-ton per month capacity, the manufacturing facility can generate turnover of around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company.
guidance.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment is cautious due to global macro uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India, supporting long-term demand.
demand_outlook.quote: With competing manufacturing hubs facing challenges such as rising costs, compliance pressures and supply- side disruptions, global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India.

demand_outlook.claim: Management indicated that they are encouraged by improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is experiencing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability, performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects trade agreements with the EU and US to drive strong growth and provide trade advantages.
demand_outlook.quote: So we are expecting very good growth with respect to both the countries we will be getting the advantage out of these trade deal.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has scope to expand manufacturing capacity by installing additional vessels for an investment of INR 3-5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex commenced commercial production at its first automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added an office in Kochi during the quarter for domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the total manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores was funded via bank loan and INR 20 crores via IPO proceeds, internal accruals, and promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs have been volatile due to global supply disruptions.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned to a manufacturing-led model to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing currently yields EBITDA margins around 25%, with management expecting margins to reach near 50% as production scales.
margins_costs.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

margins_costs.claim: Local manufacturing of two products has reduced the company's reliance on imports by 10% to 12%.
margins_costs.quote: But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have remained steady over the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The manufacturing facility in Vadodara has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: During its first two months of operation, the manufacturing facility operated at approximately 60% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Management hopes to achieve full plant capacity utilization by the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing contributed 25% and trading contributed 75% of Q3 FY26 revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a INR 30 crore term loan and INR 20 crore working capital limit.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Future working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

capital_allocation.claim: The interest rate applicable on short-term borrowings is 8.5%.
Company net worth stood at around INR 42 crores as of December end.
capital_allocation.quote: There is no major capex is on card. So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate poses a currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports experienced a temporary slowdown due to US market conditions before recovering.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a bit down in between due to the US, now it has started, so exports might even increase.

management_commitments.claim: Reach full capacity utilization of the Vadodara plant.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Launch new products following R&D trials.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization at the Vadodara manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.quote: Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal. Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
